appName.message: Tab Keeper - Chrome Tab Manager & Sync Tool
appName.description: The extension's name: the Web Store title, chrome://extensions and the toolbar tooltip. Keep "Tab Keeper" first and untranslated. At most 75 characters.

appDesc.message: Save your Chrome windows, tabs and tab groups as sessions, then sync them across desktops. No account or email needed.
appDesc.description: The Web Store summary under the title. At most 132 characters. Never say sessions sync "through Chrome sync".
